title: Brothers by House Siding, Wooden Stool - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid outdoor snapshot taken in July 1948 featuring a small toddler sitting atop a wooden step stool beside the corner of a house with clapboard siding and brick foundation. To the right, an older boy in rolled-cuff jeans and a short-sleeved collared shirt bends over attentively, looking toward the younger boy. The image has classic deckled borders typical of postwar family photography.
